Mission Local reported that the State Bar directed Brooke Jenkins to participate in a diversionary program after ethics complaints, in what the newsroom described as an unusual step involving a sitting prosecutor. Its story also said the complaints were “best resolved” by requiring her participation, and that the Bar acted on the complaint concerning her access to and sharing of a confidential rap sheet.
